# Complete Kaggle Notebook Code
# =============================

import zlib, base64

# Paste compressed strings
compressed_x = ''
compressed_y = ''

# Decompress
x_preds = list(map(float, zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(compressed_x)).decode().split(',')))
y_preds = list(map(float, zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(compressed_y)).decode().split(',')))

print(f'Loaded {len(x_preds)} predictions')
print(f'First x: {x_preds[0]}')
print(f'First y: {y_preds[0]}')
